description: Calculates the Vimshottari dasha periods of a birth chart (Swiss Ephemeris, Lahiri ayanamsa): the Moon's nakshatra at birth, the balance of the first Mahadasha, the full Mahadasha sequence from birth with start and end dates, and the Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha running on a given date plus the next two Antardashas. Use it for questions like 'which Mahadasha am I in' or 'when does my Saturn dasha start'. Dates use a 365.25-day year. The result lists the classical themes of the running periods, not predictions. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit if unknown: then houses, Ascendant and MC are not computed.
birth_time.title: Birth Time

date.description: Date to check the running periods for, YYYY-MM-DD (on or after the birth date). Defaults to today in the birth time zone.
date.title: Date

lang.description: Language of the result: en or ru.
lang.title: Lang

place.description: Birth city, e.g. 'Chicago, Illinois, USA'. Used to look up coordinates and the time zone. Not needed if latitude/longitude are given.
place.title: Place

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place, e.g. America/Chicago. Looked up from the place/coordinates when omitted.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: vimshottari_dasha
title: Vimshottari dasha periods
